_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'ACTION ITEMS LOG' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-05.13.

f01_Action_Item_Identifier_and_Descripti.label: Action Item Identifier and Description
f01_Action_Item_Identifier_and_Descripti.guidance: Unique tracking ID and concise, actionable statement of the specific task or decision follow-up.

f02_Action_Owner_and_Accountable_Role.label: Action Owner and Accountable Role
f02_Action_Owner_and_Accountable_Role.guidance: Single designated individual with primary execution and delivery accountability.

f03_Target_Completion_Date_and_Priority.label: Target Completion Date and Priority
f03_Target_Completion_Date_and_Priority.guidance: Firm committed due date and priority weighting (Critical, High, Medium, Low).

f04_Current_Execution_Status_and_Notes.label: Current Execution Status and Notes
f04_Current_Execution_Status_and_Notes.guidance: Real-time status (Open, In Progress, Blocked, Complete) with recent progress notes.

f05_Resolution_Evidence_and_Verification.label: Resolution Evidence and Verification Signoff
f05_Resolution_Evidence_and_Verification.guidance: Deliverable link, test evidence, or Project Manager formal verification confirming closure.
